# Nexus Media

> Nexus Media (NEXUS MEDIA) is a digital agency based in the Philippines offering online services: web development, system automation, video editing and social media management. It works fully online with businesses, brands and creators in the Philippines and abroad. Website: https://nexusmediaph.com

Nexus Media is one connected team for web, automation, social media and video. Clients get a free quote within 24 hours through the contact form at https://nexusmediaph.com/#contact.

## Services

- [Web development agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/web-development-agency-philippines/): custom websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores and web apps; responsive, SEO-ready, typical launch in 2–4 weeks.
- [System automation agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/system-automation-agency-philippines/): business process and workflow automation, custom business systems, inventory and sales tracking, lead capture and automated follow-up emails, content posting automation.
- [Video editing agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/video-editing-agency-philippines/): reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and long-form, video ads, motion graphics, captions, colour grading; reels delivered in about 48 hours.
- [Social media management agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/social-media-management-agency-philippines/): content strategy and calendar, post and reel design, Meta and TikTok ads, community management, monthly reports.

## Digital products

- [Blueprints](https://nexusmediaph.com/blueprints/): Windows apps for creators, including YTA & FBA Studio (one-click 2D/3D animated shorts posted to YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok) and an Auto Clipping Tool for podcasts and streams.
- [Product Calculator](https://nexusmediaph.com/calculator/): web app for food businesses covering product costing, inventory and daily sales and profit.

## Key facts

- Location: Philippines
- Service area: Philippines and worldwide, delivered online
- Best for: small and growing businesses, brands, creators, podcasters and food businesses that want web, automation, video or social media handled by one agency
